title: ちょっと寄りたいステキな場所

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back to the academy, Gold Ship pulls me onto a bus, saying there's a place she wants to go.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahh… The musty smell, the soft give of the seat, the gentle sway of the bus… I just can't get enough.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Headed? We're already here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The bus is our destination. C'mon, keep up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You can see everything worth seeing in this world on a bus!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look! That telephone pole is fighting off an ivy infestation! Hold strong, oh valiant pole!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh, that dog over there's staring right at us. I wonder if it's trying to relay a message in Morse code via nose twitches!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: F-E-E-D-M-E… Sorry, pup, I don't have any snacks on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship usually gets bored of things quickly, but the constantly changing scenery beyond the window seems to hold her attention remarkably well—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm bored of this! Let's get off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Seems I spoke too soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Time to prance, dance, and fly our way back home, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy is quite a ways from here…
choice_data_list: Bear with it and walk the distance.
Convince her to ride a different bus back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship and I get off at the next stop.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now, let's see… Where are we?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmm? It looks like we're about ten kilometers away from Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's not so bad! On deer-back, that'll only take fifteen minutes, give or take.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sit tight while I go wrangle us some deer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It takes every ounce of strength I have to stop her from going up the nearest mountain. We make it back to the academy eventually, sans deer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But if I sit still any longer, I'm gonna turn into a giant clam!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Besides, changing buses when we don't know where we are is some top-level jutsu―

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, she notices something and freezes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec. I know this route… We're on the loop headed for Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's nothing but sprawling fields and rural roads outside the windows. The academy isn't on the list of stops either.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I got bored the other day and memorized the routes for all the buses 'round here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Check out that crow! Is it awesome or what?! Okay, I'm gonna become a bird!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: From now until we get back to the academy, I'm gonna be a shoebill stork! Don't try to stop me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She starts flapping and squawking, making it impossible to confirm whether she really does know the bus route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But thirty minutes later, we pull up near Tracen Academy just as Gold Ship predicted.
choice_data_list: You really do have the routes memorized…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Arf! Grr arf! Awoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Rrright. Anyways, I'm glad we made it back safe and sound.
